name: The Master, Multiplied
oracle_text:
Myriad
The "legend rule" doesn't apply to creature tokens you control.
Triggered abilities you control can't cause you to sacrifice or exile creature tokens you control.
blocked_sentences: Triggered abilities you control can't cause you to sacrifice or exile creature tokens you control.

needs.what: a player-wide static keyed on the CAUSE being a triggered ability its controller controls, which bars that cause from making the player sacrifice, and from exiling, permanents matching an `affects` filter (here creature tokens you control: `{"controller": "you", "types": ["Creature"], "is_token": true}`). It must be read by `op_sacrifice` and by `op_exile`/`delay`-driven exiles (myriad's and Mimic Vat-style "exile the token at end of combat/end step" delayed triggers) when the resolving object is a triggered ability controlled by that player; spells, activated abilities and costs (an Altar's sacrifice) must still sacrifice and exile them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cant_sacrifice` (static or op) protects a permanent from every sacrifice, costs and activated abilities included, and says nothing of exile. `opponents_cant_force_discard_or_sacrifice` is keyed on the cause's controller being an OPPONENT, not on the cause being a triggered ability you control, and also omits exile. `replace_leaves_battlefield` replaces the destination of any departure rather than forbidding one particular cause. No static reads whether the resolving cause is a triggered ability.
